warning.titlePre: Jaguar XE D240 Timing Chain & Injector Seal Wear
paragraphs: If your XE D240 is a pre-2020 model with the Ingenium AJ200D diesel — that's the X760 generation — timing chain and injector seal wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine. We replace the timing chain and injector seals, along with other worn components, as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.
The X760-generation XE D240 is the only generation that used this engine, as the diesel option was discontinued from the UK/NA range around 2020.
warning.source: Source: widely corroborated across JLR specialist forums and independent garages, consistent with the broader Ingenium pattern, per VRF-jaguar-xe.md.
